design_intent.architecture: CNC-plywood playfield cradle with local steel pivot plates and removable industrial flange-bearing interface

loads.note: Screening only; final manual lift effort and physical proof test required.

cradle_wood_structure.rule: Primary cradle remains plywood; metal concentrated at pivot/prop/latch interfaces.

cradle_pivot_plate.material_preferred: A36 or SAE 1020 carbon steel plate
cradle_pivot_plate.plywood_mount_bolt: M8 class 8.8 through-bolt with washers and prevailing-torque/nyloc nut
cradle_pivot_plate.finish: zinc plated, epoxy primer + paint, or powder coat after all cutting/welding
cradle_pivot_plate.edge_finish: deburr and break all edges; no cable-contact sharp edges
cradle_pivot_plate.drawing_status: engineering dimensions selected; axle journal feature remains dependent on purchased bearing measurement

cradle_pivot_backing_plate.purpose: spread the four M8 clamp loads across the inside face of the ~36 mm laminated plywood pivot zone

pivot_journal.material_preferred: SAE 1045 or equivalent ground/turned steel bar
pivot_journal.attachment_to_plate: journal passes through a fitted plate hole and is jig-welded on the non-bearing/rear face; bearing journal surface remains unwelded and finish-ground/checked after welding
pivot_journal.final_projection_status: TBD after actual bearing width + cabinet-side stack measurement
pivot_journal.service_rule: journal stays with cradle plate; flange bearing is loosened/unbolted and slid off the short journal during complete cradle removal

cabinet_side_bearing.preferred_family: UCFL202 15 mm two-bolt oval flange bearing
cabinet_side_bearing.preferred_reason: cast industrial flange housing, self-aligning insert bearing, common 15 mm Brazilian-market size, stronger/serviceable alternative to light zinc KFL housing
cabinet_side_bearing.mounting: outside cabinet side panel, through-bolted through reinforced plywood with an internal steel backing/spreader plate
cabinet_side_bearing.exact_mount_hole_pattern_status: DO NOT CNC until the selected physical bearing pair is purchased and measured

cabinet_bearing_backing.final_holes: match purchased UCFL202 housing after measurement
cabinet_bearing_backing.purpose: prevent bearing fasteners crushing/creeping into plywood and distribute sidewall pivot load

axial_retention.primary: bearing inner-ring set screws on 15 mm journal plus positive external/end retention selected after bearing measurement
axial_retention.rule: final design may not rely only on bearing grub/set screws to keep the cradle attached

sequence: remove lockdown bar and playfield glass
raise cradle and engage both positive mechanical safety stays
add temporary rated support strap/prop for complete cradle removal
disconnect TV power/video at service-loop connectors
loosen positive journal retention and bearing set screws
unbolt or slide each flange bearing off its short journal
lift cradle/TV module clear with two-person handling recommended

manufacturing_notes.plate_process: laser/waterjet/plasma rough profile acceptable; critical holes drilled/reamed where required; deburr before finish
manufacturing_notes.journal_process: turn/face to bearing fit; jig perpendicular to plate during welding; verify runout/alignment after welding

manual_lift_and_safety.rule: Two independent captive pinned props. Neither friction nor an optional future assist accessory is a safety device.
